_README: OFFICIAL-SCHOOL CORRECTIONS TO THE NCAA FIXTURE RECORD.
The NCAA scoreboard + /game/{id} feed remains the base schedule source for
every fixture. This file exists for the cases where that feed is
demonstrably stale or self-contradictory and an OFFICIAL school schedule
says otherwise. It is a ledger, not a patch set: each entry names the
exact fields it is entitled to override, the direct URL it came from, the
date it was read, and the sentence it was read from.
2. `fields` lists ONLY what was explicitly verified. A correction wins
for those fields and nothing else; everything else stays canonical.
3. Never write an entry from memory, from a media report, or from a
secondary aggregator. Read the school's own schedule page.
4. Two participating schools agreeing is stronger than one and is
recorded as `corroborating_url` when available -- but the host
school's own page is sufficient for a venue it owns.
5. This file is small ON PURPOSE. It is not a route to 348 scrapers.

corrections.why: The NCAA /game record carries Rec Hall, State College PA -- Penn State's own gym -- so the hub derived site=home and rendered 'Kentucky at Penn St.'. Both schools publish the match as a NEUTRAL-site Big Ten/SEC Challenge fixture at Wrigley Field. The feed's location block is stale, not wrong-by-parsing.
corrections.quote: Big Ten/SEC Challenge neutral Sunday Sep 6 vs. Kentucky Chicago, Ill. / Wrigley Field 7:00 PM EDT
corrections.corroborating_quote: Sun. Sep 6 vs. Penn State Wrigley Field (Chicago, Ill.) 7:00 pm Big Ten / SEC Challenge
corrections.note: The feed's START TIME is already correct (7:00 PM ET) and is NOT overridden.

corrections.why: Five raw /game records for this id disagree about which side is home -- three say Nebraska, two say UNLV -- while all five agree the venue is T-Mobile Arena, which belongs to neither school. A home/away flip across snapshots at a third-party venue is itself evidence of a neutral site. Both schools publish it as neutral.
corrections.quote: Players Era Showcase Neutral Saturday Aug 29 7:00 PM CDT #1 vs. UNLV Las Vegas, Nev. / T-Mobile Arena
corrections.corroborating_quote: Players Era Volleyball Showcase Aug 29 (Sat) 5 PM PT No. 1 Nebraska Las Vegas, Nev. / T-Mobile Arena
corrections.note: 7:00 PM CDT and 5 PM PT are the same instant; the feed's epoch already agrees, so the time is NOT overridden.

corrections.why: The feed carries no location for this id at all, so the hub correctly declined to name one and rendered 'venue not reported'. Pitt's own schedule names the building and the event.
corrections.quote: Opening Spike Classic vs #15 Kansas Petersen Events Center Pittsburgh, Pa. Aug 28 (Fri) 6:30 PM ESPN2
corrections.note: SITE IS DELIBERATELY NOT CORRECTED. Pitt's page shows 'vs', which SIDEARM uses for any non-road match including neutral ones -- the same page lists 'Stanford vs. Wisconsin' at Petersen, a neutral pairing. What is verified is the venue, the city and the event. Site is left to the canonical rule, which reads venue OWNERSHIP (Petersen is Pitt's own building, on record) rather than nominal home ordering.
